quests.instruction: Buns are cooked gently in a bamboo basket set over a simmering pot. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This cooking method relies on gentle heat carried by rising moisture.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Buns are cooked gently in a basket over simmering water, using rising moisture, which is this word!
quests.funFact: Steaming cooks food using the hot vapor of boiling water.

quests.instruction: An apple's skin can be removed in one long curly strip. Which word fits?
quests.hint: A careful cook can sometimes do this in one long, unbroken strip.
quests.explanation: Yes! An apple's skin can be removed in one long strip, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Peeling removes the tough outer skin from fruits and vegetables.

quests.instruction: A birthday cake and a batch of muffins are cooked this way in the oven. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word means cooking something surrounded by an oven's warm, dry air.
quests.explanation: That's right! A cake and muffins are both cooked surrounded by an oven's warm, dry air!
quests.funFact: Baking uses dry heat, usually in an oven, to cook food slowly.

quests.instruction: Fish fillets are cooked gently above simmering water until they flake apart easily. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This method is often used for delicate foods that could fall apart if boiled.
quests.explanation: Great job! Fish fillets are cooked gently above simmering water, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: It is one of the healthiest ways to cook vegetables because it traps vitamins inside.

quests.instruction: A leg of lamb is cooked slowly in a hot oven for a big family dinner. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This method is often used for a big cut of meat, cooked low and slow.
quests.explanation: You got it! A leg of lamb is cooked slowly in a hot oven, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Roasting uses high heat in an oven to brown the outside of food.

quests.instruction: Pancake batter is stirred until the lumps disappear. What's the word for this step?
quests.hint: This word describes stirring or blending ingredients into one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Pancake batter is stirred and blended into one smooth mixture, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Mixing combines different ingredients together until they are one.

quests.instruction: A casserole and a tray of dinner rolls are cooked slowly in the oven. What's the cooking word?
quests.hint: This word describes cooking food surrounded by even, dry heat.
quests.explanation: Correct! A casserole and dinner rolls are both cooked surrounded by even, dry heat!
quests.funFact: Bread, cakes, and cookies are all made by baking dough or batter.

quests.instruction: Fish fillets and pineapple slices are cooked over an open outdoor flame. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This cooking word usually needs a grate and a fire underneath.
quests.explanation: Super! Fish fillets and pineapple slices are both cooked over an open outdoor flame with a grate!
quests.funFact: Grilling cooks food quickly over an open flame or hot coals.

quests.instruction: Noodles and hot dogs are often cooked in a pot of fast-bubbling water. What's the word?
quests.hint: This is the hottest way that plain water can cook something.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Noodles and hot dogs are both cooked in water at its hottest, fastest-bubbling point!
quests.funFact: Boiling means heating water until it bubbles rapidly at 212 degrees.

quests.instruction: Bell peppers are cut into small squares for a stir fry. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes using a knife to make one food into many small bits.
quests.explanation: You found it! Bell peppers are cut into small squares for a stir fry, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Chopping uses a sharp knife to cut food into small, bite-sized pieces.

quests.instruction: Broccoli is cooked gently over a pot of bubbling water, never touching it. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method cooks food using hot rising vapor, not the water itself.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Broccoli is cooked over bubbling water using rising vapor, which is what this word means!
quests.funFact: Steamed dumplings are a very popular dish in many Asian countries.

quests.instruction: A whole duck is cooked in the oven until its skin turns crispy and golden. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method usually needs a rack and a pan to catch the drippings.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! A whole duck is cooked in the oven until crispy and golden, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Roasted vegetables get incredibly sweet and crispy on the edges.

quests.instruction: A tray of whole garlic bulbs is cooked slowly in the oven until soft and sweet. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This cooking method uses steady, dry heat for a long time.
quests.explanation: Terrific! A tray of garlic bulbs is cooked slowly in dry oven heat until sweet, which is this word!
quests.funFact: People often roast turkeys and large cuts of meat for holiday dinners.

quests.instruction: Celery is cut into small pieces before being added to a salad. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This is the step that comes right after washing your vegetables.
quests.explanation: Yes! Celery is cut into small pieces before adding to a salad, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Chefs learn to chop vegetables incredibly fast to save time.

quests.instruction: A watermelon is cut into thin, juicy pieces to share at a picnic. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This is what you do with a knife to make thin, flat pieces.
quests.explanation: That's right! A watermelon is cut into thin, flat pieces to share, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Slicing means cutting food into thin, flat pieces.

quests.instruction: Hot dogs and chicken skewers are cooked over hot coals outside. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This cooking method often happens outdoors, over charcoal or a flame.
quests.explanation: Great job! Hot dogs and chicken skewers are both cooked over hot coals outdoors!
quests.funFact: It gives food a smoky flavor and leaves dark grill marks.

quests.instruction: Herbs like parsley are cut into tiny pieces to sprinkle on top of a dish. What's the word?
quests.hint: This step turns one big piece of food into many small ones.
quests.explanation: You got it! Herbs are cut into tiny pieces to sprinkle on top, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Chopping onions releases a gas that can make your eyes water.

quests.instruction: Banana bread and a batch of brownies are made using this oven method. What's it called?
quests.hint: This method usually needs a pan and a preheated oven.
quests.explanation: Well done! Banana bread and brownies are both made using this dry, oven-based cooking method!
quests.funFact: Baking changes liquid batter into a solid, fluffy cake.

quests.instruction: Onion rings and chicken nuggets are cooked in bubbling hot oil. What's the word?
quests.hint: This is the crispiest, oiliest way to cook a food quickly.
quests.explanation: Correct! Onion rings and chicken nuggets are both cooked in bubbling hot oil!
quests.funFact: Frying cooks food quickly in very hot oil or butter.

quests.instruction: An onion is cut into small pieces before going into the soup pot. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This word means cutting food into small pieces with a knife.
quests.explanation: Super! An onion is cut into small pieces before cooking, which is exactly what this word means!
quests.funFact: You need a sturdy cutting board to chop food safely.

quests.instruction: Whole potatoes are cooked in the oven until crispy on the outside. What's the word?
quests.hint: This cooking method usually needs a pan and a hot oven.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Whole potatoes are cooked in the oven until crispy outside, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Roasting a marshmallow over a fire makes it gooey and delicious.

quests.instruction: Rice and lentils can both be cooked this way in a pot of hot water. What's the word?
quests.hint: This is the cooking method right as water turns into steam.
quests.explanation: You found it! Rice and lentils can both be cooked this way, right as water turns into steam!
quests.funFact: Pasta and rice must be boiled in water to make them soft.

quests.instruction: A carrot's thin outer layer is scraped away before cooking. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This step happens before chopping, not after.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! A carrot's thin outer layer is scraped away before chopping, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: A potato peeler makes it very fast to take the skin off a potato.

quests.instruction: Kebabs and sausages are cooked on skewers over an open flame. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method usually turns your food over halfway through with long tongs.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Kebabs and sausages are both cooked on skewers over an open flame, flipped with tongs!
quests.funFact: Burgers and hot dogs are classic foods cooked on a grill.

quests.instruction: Trail mix is made by combining nuts, dried fruit, and chocolate together. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This word means bringing separate foods together into one bowl or bag.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Trail mix is made by combining nuts, dried fruit, and chocolate together, which is this word!
quests.funFact: You use a spoon or a whisk to mix batter for pancakes.

quests.instruction: A loaf of banana bread is cut into thin pieces to serve at breakfast. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes making thin, even cuts through a food.
quests.explanation: Yes! A loaf of banana bread is cut into thin pieces to serve, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: A loaf of bread is sliced so it can be used for sandwiches.

quests.instruction: Burgers and corn on the cob get cooked over an open flame outside. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method leaves dark stripe marks on your food.
quests.explanation: That's right! Burgers and corn on the cob are both cooked over an open flame, leaving stripe marks!
quests.funFact: You have to flip food on a grill so it cooks evenly on both sides.

quests.instruction: Corn on the cob and hard-boiled eggs are cooked in fast-bubbling water. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes water at its most active, bubbling stage.
quests.explanation: Great job! Corn on the cob and hard-boiled eggs are both cooked in water at its most active stage!
quests.funFact: Boiling water kills harmful bacteria to make it safe to drink.

quests.instruction: Rice can be cooked gently using hot rising vapor instead of boiling. What's the word?
quests.hint: This is a gentler cooking method than a rolling boil.
quests.explanation: You got it! Rice can be cooked gently using hot rising vapor, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: You do not need any oil or butter to steam food.

quests.instruction: A tortilla and a plantain slice are cooked in a hot, oiled skillet. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This cooking word is often paired with the word 'pan' before it.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tortilla and a plantain slice are both cooked in a hot, oiled skillet!
quests.funFact: French fries get their crispy texture from being deep-fried.
